patch_list: Removes all ads. Opt-in rewarded ads keep working.
Fixes the app not starting after patching.
Hides event banners, the home pop-up and the floating event icon.
Hides the Ad-Free button at the top of the Home and Prayer screens.
Hides the login, Nearby, Feeds, theme store, recharge and watch-ad reward units.
Hides the friends, badge and shortcut cards on the Me tab.
Hides the Messages tab from the bottom bar.
Hides the membership banners and pop-ups.
Hides the Egg and Rebates shortcuts.
